meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 GitHub 仓库的 issue 列表，按根本原因将多个相关 issue 归为一组，创建一个主 issue 和设计文档，关闭子 issue 并添加重定向评论，最后生成一个能一次性关闭所有相关 issue 的 PR。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上 open issue 且很多看起来重复，或用户要求“整理”、“归类”、“去重”、“制定计划”时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这个仓库的 issue，按根本原因分组。
这个新 bug 属于哪个已有的计划？
为这个计划生成一个能关闭所有子 issue 的 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the GitHub issue list, groups related issues by root cause into clusters, creates a master issue and design doc per cluster, closes child issues with a redirect comment, and generates a PR that closes all children atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the repo has 20+ open issues with many duplicates, or when the user asks to 'triage', 'consolidate', 'cluster', 'dedupe', or 'make a plan from' the issue list.

say_en.text: Help me triage this repo's issues by root cause.
say_en.note: Claude reads all issues, creates masters, and closes children.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Claude matches the bug to a master and appends a Round-N comment.

say_en.text: Create a PR that closes all children of this plan.
say_en.note: Claude generates a PR with Closes #N for each child.
